dedupe_keys.name: maritime urban tracking data reader and processing library

description: NTNU Autosight publishes a Python reader and processing library for the Maritime Urban Tracking harbor sensor dataset. The own GitHub repository declares MIT and its README maps recording files to scenarios and provides examples for reading the data. The article also describes a polarization-camera demosaicking routine in the code. A modeller can use these functions to prepare vessel tracks or perception outputs for autonomous maritime traffic simulation. Coverage is the two-day MUT recording campaign and its separate NIRD full and sample DOIs. A caveat is that a reader does not supply a vessel dynamics model, and some recording formats depend on the team's proprietary capture software. Users should pin a code revision or the linked Zenodo snapshot when reproducing results. I read the own GitHub and Zenodo metadata plus article code statement without cloning code, downloading video or running a tracking model. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
